mcp.instructions: Access to the owner's investment portfolio: positions, portfolio summary, and weekly AI analyses (read tools), plus conversational maintenance (write tools): update_position (partial; large quantity changes need confirm=true), create_position, set_order_execution_status (optionally with execution price), and trigger_price_refresh. There is no delete tool — close a holding via update_position with status 'closed'. Every write is recorded in an audit trail queryable via list_audit_entries.
